'''Strike Force One''' was a combat element of [[Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT]]. Strike Force One, alongside [[Strike Force Two]], were deployed to assault the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[GrimDeath I]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWS" />
